notes.title: MidKnight Story Demo – Update v1.045
notes.content:
[h3]MidKnight Story Demo – Update v1.045[/h3][p]Hello everyone![/p][p]A new update for the [b]MidKnight Story demo (v1.045)[/b] is now live on Steam! This version focuses on polish, bug fixes, and smoother gameplay flow.[/p][p]What’s New[/p][list][*][p][b]New stopping animations[/b] – more realistic, smoother, and precise for both run and sprint.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061489/a1b511774ff042770bb5a0b29bce388c437aaee7.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Improved chest interaction[/b] – easier to trigger thanks to better stopping animations, wider interaction areas, and refined chest collision.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Movement improvements[/b] – dodges are easier and more frequent, while running turn animations appear only when they should.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Combat flow[/b] – Paran reacts much faster when damaged, keeping combat more fluid.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Exploration[/b] – smoother transitions for better traversal flow.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual updates[/b] – new shoes, pants, backpack, hairstyle, and goggles![/p][list][*][p]Clothes feature [b]better rigging and textures[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Backpack is now fully rigged to the character with [b]improved loot animations[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061489/d666b8e38139ee2573a4b9d9c0d898950f0105f2.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The new [b]goggles[/b] will play a role in the next update, introducing a [b]radar system[/b] to detect climbable ledges and points of interest.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Improved IK system[/b] – more natural pelvis rotation across animations + polished animations (like reload when not aiming).[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI refinements[/b] – small quality-of-life tweaks for keyboard users.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug fixes[/b] – e.g. fixed the [b]camera intersecting sandy landscapes[/b] and showing what was beneath the level.[/p][/*][/list][p]Coming in September[/p][list][*][p]New [b]shirt and jacket[/b] for Paran.[/p][/*][*][p]Further [b]UI improvements[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded [b]combat polish[/b], focusing on execution mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p]The new [b]radar system via goggles[/b] for clearer exploration and climbing.[/p][/*][/list][p]After the September update, I’ll finally be ready to reveal [b]new content[/b] I’ve been working on in the background — stay tuned![/p][p]Thanks for playing and for all your feedback!
— Mattia[/p]

tags.feature: New stopping animations – more realistic, smoother, and precise for both run and sprint.
Improved chest interaction – easier to trigger thanks to better stopping animations, wider interaction areas, and refined chest collision.
Movement improvements – dodges are easier and more frequent, while running turn animations appear only when they should.
Combat flow – Paran reacts much faster when damaged, keeping combat more fluid.
Exploration – smoother transitions for better traversal flow.
Visual updates – new shoes, pants, backpack, hairstyle, and goggles!
Clothes feature better rigging and textures.
Backpack is now fully rigged to the character with improved loot animations.
The new goggles will play a role in the next update, introducing a radar system to detect climbable ledges and points of interest.
Improved IK system – more natural pelvis rotation across animations + polished animations (like reload when not aiming).
UI refinements – small quality-of-life tweaks for keyboard users.

tags.bug: Bug fixes – e.g. fixed the camera intersecting sandy landscapes and showing what was beneath the level.
